name: research
description: Materialize reproducible experiments across verified GPU rigs: scaffold projects, provision exact environments, deploy tested revisions, dispatch GPU waves as a self-balancing pull queue, supervise them from the hub without an open chat, keep a fleet-wide GPU lane board, and visualize results.

interface.shortDescription: Reproducible GPU experiments across verified rigs
interface.longDescription: Scaffold fresh Research 2.0 projects without questions (finding or creating the private GitHub repo and moving secrets the safe way), then act autonomously inside the engineering envelope, logging every decision to a project decision log and asking only before destructive, credential-changing, or envelope-expanding steps, with shared-GPU ownership enforced in code, provision exact uv environments, give every run a versioned hash identity that can be migrated to new swept params, deploy tested revisions, dispatch GPU waves as a pull queue over rig lanes and Slurm jobs, supervise them with a hub service and an unattended agent (rebalancing, fault recovery, offload of disk-constrained rigs, evaluation collection to the hub, per-GPU status table), keep a fleet-wide board of which rig GPUs every project holds, reconcile run state, maintain a narrative journal, and create self-contained result visualizations with a hash-to-params Runs view.
defaultPrompt: Scaffold a fresh Research 2.0 project with engineering, environment, and rig contracts.
Provision the exact uv environment and verify parity across my rigs.
Compile an approved research step into a reproducible experiment and monitor its GPU wave through completion.
Plot my evaluation results as self-contained interactive HTML and tell me why each title and path was chosen.
Which GPUs are free across my projects right now, and who holds the rest until when?
